output.text: Assume that Pia is the lead volunteer. The morning began quietly along the edge of the marsh, where mist still clung to the reeds and the air smelled faintly of damp grass. Ivo arrived a few minutes before Uma, both carrying binoculars slung around their necks, while Dara showed up shortly after with a battered field guide tucked under one arm. Pia was slightly taller than Otto, though Dara stood taller than either of them. Otto brought the first-aid kit. Everyone gathered near the wooden gate to check their gear before setting off toward the trees. Ivo and Uma were on different teams. Someone mentioned that a heron had been spotted near the old bridge the previous week, which sparked a round of excited chatter. Uma and Dara were on different teams. Otto, who had arrived last, jogged to catch up with the others, his boots squelching in the mud. Pia mentioned that the light was perfect for photographing warblers, and Uma nodded in agreement. Ivo and Dara were on different teams. As the walk continued, Dara pointed out a woodpecker tapping steadily against a hollow trunk, and Ivo raised his binoculars to get a better look. There were three teams. By midmorning, everyone had reassembled near the visitor center, comparing notes on the birds they had seen and sharing sips of water from their bottles. Otto was younger than Pia but older than Ivo, and Uma, who ranked highest on the morning's species count, laughed as she recounted spotting a kingfisher darting low over the water.
